_metadata.description: Requirements for rate-aware autonomous disk recovery and its typed evidence surfaces.

requirements.title: Autonomous recovery admits safe and regenerable tiers
requirements.description: When a pressure report starts recovery, the controller MUST admit safe and proven regenerable providers and MUST withhold conditional and forbidden providers without their required authority.

validation.notes: Pressure gate tests cover autonomous tier selection.

requirements.title: Recovery restores a free-space target
requirements.description: The recovery controller MUST run bounded batches, re-measure free space, and stop when the configured free-space target or an authority boundary is reached.

validation.notes: Controller tests cover target, budget, and batch termination.

requirements.title: Recovery runs hold a host lock
requirements.description: A recovery run MUST hold the host recovery lock while deleting and a concurrent run MUST report the held lock without deleting.

validation.notes: Advisory lock ownership is tested across competing holders.

requirements.title: Recovery evidence uses typed integer fields
requirements.description: The ledger MUST store run and action byte counts, file counts, durations, free-space changes, authority, and terminal reason in typed columns.

validation.notes: Ledger persistence tests verify typed recovery rows.

requirements.title: Governed roots carry regenerability proof
requirements.description: A regenerable root MUST declare a recreating producer, exact containment, and no active lease before autonomous recovery may select it.

validation.notes: Built-in root declarations and proof metadata are validated.

requirements.title: Owner budgets authorize R2 cleanup
requirements.description: An owner storage entry MUST be regenerable and declare an age or byte budget before the recovery controller may use it without a second approval.

validation.notes: Owner-provider linkage and budget authority are tested.

requirements.title: Pressure reports carry writer rate
requirements.description: Pressure reports MUST carry fill rate, hot writers, and trigger, and the shared classifier MUST determine the pressure band for every sender.

validation.notes: Shared pressure contract and classification tests pass.

requirements.title: Writer snapshots identify hot roots
requirements.description: The rate sensor MUST persist one writer snapshot per governed root and MUST emit a named hot-writer event after a complete sensor window above the configured limit.

validation.notes: Rate and hot-writer tests cover snapshot deltas and event naming.

requirements.title: Standing approvals are host-local
requirements.description: A conditional recovery provider MUST require a named standing approval whose host identity and subject constraints match the current host.

validation.notes: Setup discovery rejects host mismatch and applies only selected approvals.

requirements.title: Recovery emits typed events and a work record
requirements.description: Each recovery run MUST emit started and completed events and MUST append one work-record journal note after reclaimed bytes are confirmed.

validation.notes: Recovery journal append and failure isolation are tested.
